This report cannot be published yet -- 6 separate issue(s) found, ALL listed here so they can be fixed in one pass rather than one preview_report attempt per issue:
[1] validation refused: the assertion "Greta Thunberg said 'The climate crisis is a matter of life and death.'" is an attribution, not a claim. Whether someone said it is never the thing under test. Drop the 'X said:' lead, keep the quoted statement as the assertion, and grade THAT against the warehouse (join its components at county, state or year grain and test them) or against independent figures.
[2] validation refused: 1 claim(s) have no warehouse figure and no sign an outside check was attempted: "Greta Thunberg said 'The climate crisis is a matter of life and death.'". Finding nothing is acceptable; not looking is not. For each one, web_fetch the report, release or dataset the article cites or that would carry the figure (any outcome counts, a 403 or timeout included) and list that URL in the claim's `sources`, or run web searches for it and list the queries in `searched`. Fetching the article itself does not count. Then grade on what the check found.
[3] validation refused: claims are graded against https://climateactiontracker.org/documents/1451/CAT_2026-11-12_GlobalUpdate_COP31.pdf and no page on climateactiontracker.org was read. You MUST web_fetch the publisher's page that lists this document (https://climateactiontracker.org/ when you know no other). Then publish again.
[4] validation refused: the article https://insideclimatenews.org/news/12112026/cop31-global-warming-warnings/ did not load, so its claims were not read from its text. web_search the headline or a distinctive sentence for a copy of the same story (a syndication partner, the wire service, an archive), web_fetch it, extract the claims from that text, and name it in `article_copy_url`.
[5] validation refused: the assertion "Turkey and Australia, COP31 hosts, opposed the word 'clean' in electrification targets (per Höhne)." is graded 'unsupported' with no warehouse figure and no `measure`. search_catalog for the statistic it rests on, with its place, and put that query in `measure`.
[6] validation refused: claim 2 is graded 'mostly true' and its `inaccuracy` ("1.9C (3.4F) is CAT's optimistic scenario (all announced targets incl. net zero fully met); full implementation of 2030/2035 NDCs gives 2.6C and pledges and targets 2.1C. Wording as relayed blurs this, and policies in place give 2.7C.") names no difference between the claim and the evidence. `inaccuracy` MUST say what the claim gets wrong ("the claim says X; the evidence says Y"). An estimate, projection, preliminary, revised or secondary-source figure, or one the warehouse does not hold, MUST NOT be graded below 'true' on that ground. If nothing in the claim differs from the evidence, the verdict MUST be 'true'; if no evidence was found, it MUST be 'unsupported' ALSO: claim 6 fell short of true and supported but carries no valid `errs` (toward_thesis | against_thesis | neutral).
